description: Resolve a place the user mentions (station, borough, neighbourhood, postcode, street) to ids. Station lookup forgives spelling (Kings Cross, St James Park, Elephant and Castle) and knows London codes and nicknames (KX, TCR, LST, E&C, ally pally). Returns stations (osm:…, with TfL modes, lines and zone; twin stations such as Hammersmith are listed apart) for find_areas.near_stations, local authorities (uk:lad:…; London's boroughs) for find_areas.boroughs, areas (with ladId) and addresses for get (typed ids: uk:lsoa:…, pc:…, uprn:…) and assess_listing, and venues (a pool, gym or sports centre by name, with latitude/longitude to pin as a place). best is the likeliest meaning: a venue named exactly so, then a town, city or council named exactly so above a stop that only shares the name; 'Liverpool St' is the station. A street found only outside the town typed gives best null, reason town-mismatch and candidates with their towns: ask which. query is an alias of q.

q.description: [search: contains] Any case: a station, borough, neighbourhood, street or venue (a pool, gym, sports centre). A full postcode matches exactly.
